title: Bring HN reference router live after provider key correction
description: The shared Cyclotron provider secret now holds the TypeSafe key. A live smoke attempt on 2026-10-21 (one item, router flipped live for one invocation, then restored to dry-run) was refused by Cyclotron with run_busy: command job bf25e156 on the standing run is claimed and running with no result, left by the earlier wrong-key attempt; its queue message is in the dead-letter queue. The worker refuses to reclaim it by design (running command requires scoped reconciliation). Router is in dry-run, 115 items waiting. Needs an owner-approved reconciliation of that one job before the bounded live pass, the live flip and the two-cycle watch.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-21 17:43Z: router set live with maxItemsPerRun=1 and invoked once (task=route); Cyclotron answered 409 run_busy, sweep stopped, nothing consumed, no job marker written. Router restored to dry-run (maxItemsPerRun 5, feedback true). Cause: job bf25e156 on run 566df5dc is status running (owner 32234c16, fence 1, no result); the worker raised after claiming it during the wrong-key Jev call, so every redelivery fails closed and the message sits in cyclotron-console-commands-dlq. Worker container is cold (last invocation 03:26Z) so the new key will be read on the next call. Blocked on owner-approved reconciliation of that one job. Old key: also in Amplify OPENAI_API_KEY (2 apps) and Chatticus thin-turn (3 stages).

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-21 18:15Z: wedge cleared, root cause of the repeating worker failure still unknown. Cyclotron PR 85/86 merged and released to main: python -m decision_flywheel.command_recovery diagnose|reconcile (dry-run default, owner+fence match, audit record as job result, evidence refusal, matching DLQ message only). Applied to bf25e156 (reason as approved), then to two further jobs wedged by my smoke attempts (f5868e71, c1e4cfcb). AWSPREVIOUS label removed from cyclotron/providers/openai (the unlabeled old version is still retrievable by explicit version id until Secrets Manager prunes it; rotate the key). Direct Jev call with the secret: 200, 158 ms, choice include, 318 in/31 out tokens. A local replay of the DEPLOYED 0.31.0 worker code against an in-memory copy of the books bucket completes the decide fine (label/confidence/decisionId produced). In the real worker Lambda the same decide fails in ~10.0 s after the secret is read, leaving the job running; with TYPESAFE_LOG_LEVEL=info no SDK request was logged, so it fails before any provider request. The worker logs no exception by design. Next: ship a sanitized diagnostic (exception class and file:line only) in worker_handler, or find the Lambda-only difference; then smoke, bounded pass, live flip. Router is dry-run (maxItemsPerRun 5); route 50108717 cleaned (attempt 4).

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-21 18:40Z: Cyclotron PR 87 (sanitized worker failure log: exception classes, code locations, elapsed and remaining ms; no messages or payloads) is released to main as 0.33.0, but NOT deployed. main pushes do not deploy the lab stack: cyclotron-console is a hand-run SAM stack and infra/lab/README.md says every deploy needs Ryan's explicit approval and a change-set review. Waiting on that approval. Grep for a 10 s deadline found only 10 s read timeouts on the S3, KMS and Secrets Manager clients (cloud_entry.py) and httpx timeout=10 in the accounts clients; none explains an exit at 10.0 s, so the diagnostic is still needed. The two redelivered queue messages were consumed by terminal-status returns; both queues are empty. Router remains dry-run.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-21 20:00Z: router LIVE (maxItemsPerRun 5, feedback true; Anth.us, p.apyr.us, Threat Intelligence). Root cause found with the 0.33.0 worker diagnostic: reserve raised 'explicit retry required' for a failed shared request left by the earlier wrong-key attempt and it escaped unrecorded after the claim. Fixed in Cyclotron 0.33.1 (recorded source_refused refusal; post-dispatch failures stay fail-closed); both releases deployed to cyclotron-console by change set (Code only; LabVerifierEnabled=true, set by a concurrent deploy, preserved). Smoke: 2 items, 3 decisions each. Bounded pass: 15 decided + 2 refused (source_refused). Per publication: anth-us 0 include / 15 exclude, p-apyr-us 0 / 15, threat-intelligence 2 include / 13 exclude; 2 pending References delivered to TI, none auto-accepted. Watch 19:22, 19:37, 19:52 router runs + 19:28, 19:43 collector runs: 0 errors, decisions 15 -> 30, 4 pending TI References total. Data Parade had been added to the router publications by someone else; removed for live (its POST returns 409 pending criteria and stops the sweep); backup of the prior config is not committed. Backlog drains at 5 per run against the 100/day Cyclotron ceiling.
